text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER (sev=P1) - Serving runtime alerts across cluster. Symptoms: repeated CUDA OOMs, container restarts, and high IB retransmit rates leading to multi-node flaps. Affected service: /v1/generate (replicas in rack-a and rack-b). Paging infra-oncall. thread_ts=2062000456

sanjay: taking this. oncall-1 here. pinging infra-sre and checking logs.

elaine: I'm seeing lots of ib_retransmit and link_down on rack-a nodes. tcp retransmits spike right before container OOMs.

carla: stack traces in pod logs show GPU alloc failures immediately after network timeouts. sample log:```
2026-03-15T20:07:12Z serving-ldr kernel: nv_alloc: cudaMalloc failed: out of memory
2026-03-15T20:07:12Z serving-ldr containerd: pod/encoder-7f9 crashed with SIGABRT
2026-03-15T20:07:12Z host kern: mlx5_core 0000:03:00.0: mlx5e: port 1 link down
```

elaine: running quick checks: `kubectl get pods -n serving -o wide | grep CrashLoop` and `ethtool -S ib0 | grep retransmit`

raj: customer-facing: we're seeing a ~4% error rate for /v1/generate and a handful of customer 502s. Triage message staged to affected customers, will update once we know mitigation.

infra-sre: can we isolate the fabric issue? suggestion: cordon affected nodes and fail traffic to spare pool, or disable RDMA on the nodes while we investigate. Risk: perf hit.

sanjay: plan A: 1) enable model-fallback routing to CPU-quantized model for new requests 2) cordon and drain most impacted nodes in rack-a to stop flapping 3) if IB link remains unstable, temporarily disable RDMA on those hosts and force TCP fallback.

carla: enabling fallback now via console routing policy (canary to quantized-small). monitor token throughput. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

ops-bot: deployment:route-update succeeded - route /v1/generate -> quantized-small (5% canary -> 100% fallback).

elaine: starting node isolation. commands:```
# cordon/drain
kubectl cordon node-rack-a-07
kubectl drain node-rack-a-07 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force -n serving
# ifrdma needed
sudo systemctl stop rdma.service || true
ip link set dev ib0 down || true
```

infra-sre: while you drain, also collect packet capture and mlx counters: `/usr/sbin/ibdiagnet -v` and `tcpdump -i ib0 -w /tmp/ib-pkt.pcap`

elaine: running ibdiagnet now. early output shows excessive retries on ports 1 & 2, ECN marking spikes. attaching short excerpt:```
port 1 retries: 1200
port 2 retries: 980
link_down events: 3 in last 10m
```

raj: updated customers: short blurb sent — "We are investigating network-related issues causing some request failures. We're failing over to a fallback model to maintain availability; performance may be degraded. We'll post another update in 30m."

sanjay: metrics check: error rate dropping to 1.2% since fallback enabled. latency up ~60ms p95. Good sign.

carla: rolling back restart-prone serving pod (image pinned to previous working SHA) on node-rack-b-03 to reduce churn.```
kubectl set image deployment/encoder encoder=registry/redwood/encoder@sha256:abcdef1234 -n serving
```

ops-bot: rollout started for deployment/encoder - status: progressing.

elaine: one node (node-rack-a-07) had persistent IB link flaps even after disabling RDMA; kernel logs show repeated firmware errors. I've marked it as maintenance and opened a hardware ticket.

infra-sre: for short-term mitigation we'll keep RDMA disabled on the 3 worst nodes and move traffic to Dedicated pool in other racks. Also increasing autoscaler min to absorb capacity gap.

sanjay: preparing handoff — I'm switching off pager at 21:30 UTC. Elaine, can you take next oncall? I'll leave runbook steps in the incident doc.

elaine: taking next. confirm items: 1) fallback routing set 2) 3 nodes with RDMA disabled 3) hardware ticket opened for node-rack-a-07 4) customer comms sent 5) monitor p95 and error-rate. I'll escalate to hw team if link continues to flap.

oncall-next: ack, I'll be available for escalation after 22:00 UTC.

carla: postmortem notes started. immediate action list in the doc: - investigate firmware logs, - verify mlx5 firmware versions across rack-a, - run long ibdiagnet sweep, - automate RDMA-disable + redistribute.

raj: will follow up with updated customer incident timeline and record impacted tenants. linking support tickets: #INC-13456 #INC-13457.

incident-bot: incident acknowledged. Current status: mitigated (fallback active), degraded performance, hardware ticket open, oncall handoff to elaine at 21:30 UTC.

elaine: closing loop for now — continuing to monitor, will update if state changes. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: thread archived when last_message_ts=2062000545"
